exemplar_1.why: UK-specific horticultural authority with calendar-structured, non-commercial editorial content and clear seasonal guidance for ordinary gardeners.

exemplar_2.why: Month-by-month garden task structure, plain practical tone, UK climate framing, and editorial-first content without product-led commercial distraction.

exemplar_3.why: Structured comparison articles covering home and garden categories with honest 'what it's bad at' framing and a non-brand-promotional editorial stance.
